doc: Coming home (issue #67): the re-entry mechanic's values per craft, read by scripts/flight/reentry.gd. Real values carry their source; the corridor, the drift and the compressed times are game values, said on screen. Each craft brings its own texts (blackout_note, down_in, sources_line) and either the blackout's real seconds (blackout_start_s, blackout_end_s) or its share of the plasma (blackout_from, blackout_to).

apollo13.simplified: The corridor's edges, the drift and the pace are our game values; the plasma lasts 24 s here, the real blackout 3 min 19 s.
apollo13.blackout_note: Houston can only wait (3 min 19 s for real).
apollo13.down_in: %s is down in the Pacific Ocean, %s. The recovery ship USS Iwo Jima was about four miles away.

artemis1.down_in: %s is down in the Pacific off San Diego, %s, at 12:40 p.m. EST, after 25 days, 10 hours and 53 minutes.
artemis1.simplified: The corridor's edges, the drift, the pace and the parachute heights are our game values; the speed and the splashdown are NASA's.
